spans.s:
The words त्यद् etc. are called वृद्धम्।

Terms: वृद्धम्

The pronouns त्यद् etc. when spoken of along with any other noun, (pronoun other than त्यद् etc.) are always retained as एकशेष (to the exclusion of others).

Terms: एकशेष

And the affix कञ् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' when it is in composition with त्यद् etc. and does not signify perception.

Terms: कञ्

The acute accent is optionally on the first syllables of त्याग , राग , हास , कुह , श्वठ , and क्रथ।

Terms: accent-word

For the final of त्यद् etc. there is substituted अ when an affix called विभक्ति follows.

Terms: सर्वनाम
